ch5_theory_04.t: Suppose you saved him. Without knowing it.

ch5_theory_06.t: And suppose everything since is... the universe doing its paperwork.

ch5_theory_10.t: I have no idea. But it is a very good theory, and I have been saving it.

ch5_spiral_03.t: No. I'm not. I'm not doing that.

ch5_leave_02.t: Do not do anything rash, Mister Mercer.

ch6_res_drop_03.t: Somebody's out here setting this up for him.

ch6_res_vend_03.t: He's eating a snack. A snack fell out.

ch6_res_gen_02.t: Was that a bird? Did a bird...
